name: project-room
description: One project from plan to delivery: the plan, the work in progress, the risks and the decisions, and the updates people outside the project read.
welcome: This room runs one project. The plan is pinned in #plan; post progress in #work, risks in #risks and decisions in #decisions. #updates is what people outside the project read.

sections.name: Plan
sections.rules: Change the plan here first, then tell #updates.

sections.name: Delivery
sections.rules: One piece of work a thread; say when it is done and how it was checked.

channels.name: updates
channels.purpose: Weekly status for people outside the project
channels.rules: Short: what moved, what is next, what needs help.

channels.name: decisions
channels.purpose: Decisions and their reasons, one a post
channels.rules: One decision a post: the decision, why, the date and who owns it.

channels.name: risks
channels.purpose: Risks and blockers, with an owner each

channels.name: work
channels.purpose: Work in progress, one thread each

channels.name: review
channels.purpose: Reviews of finished work before it ships
